금색 번호는 천주교 서울 순례길의 순례지입니다. 해설사와 함께 걷는 프로: Gold numbers are sites of the Seoul Catholic Pilgrimage Routes. These are guided programs and must be booked in advance.
해설은 무료입니다(입장료·체험료·교통비는 개인 부담). 영어·일본어·중국: Guiding is free (admission, activity and transport costs are your own). Tours are also available in English, Japanese, Chinese, Vietnamese, Malay, Indonesian, Thai and sign language.
세 해설 코스는 순례지 일부에 주변 명소를 더한 관광형 코스입니다. 북촌: The three guided walks are sightseeing courses that add nearby landmarks to some of the pilgrimage sites. The Bukchon walk shares only the Gwanghwamun Beatification Site, Gahoe-dong Catholic Church and Seokjeong Boreum Well (end of the Way of the Word to start of the Way of Life); the Seosomun walk shares Myeongdong Cathedral, the Seosomun Martyrs’ Shrine and Yakhyeon Catholic Church (start of the Way of the Word, end of the Way of Life); and the Han River walk shares only Jeoldusan Martyrs’ Shrine (Way of Unity). Danggogae, Saenamteo, Samseongsan and the other shrines on the Way of Unity are not included. Use the three courses above for pilgrimage, and the guided walks for first-time visitors or young pilgrims from abroad.
개인은 3일 전까지(다음 달 예약은 매월 15일부터), 단체는 5개월~5: Individuals up to 3 days ahead (next month’s bookings open on the 15th), groups 5 months to 5 days ahead. Recommended for upper elementary age and up; children under 14 without a guardian will be turned away.

말씀의 길이 끝나는 가회동성당에서 생명의 길이, 생명의 길이 끝나는 약현: The Way of Life begins at Gahoe-dong Catholic Church where the Way of the Word ends, and the Way of Unity begins at Yakhyeon Catholic Church where the Way of Life ends. You can walk one course a day.
도심 안을 걷는 말씀의 길(8.7km)·생명의 길(5.9km)은 반나절,: The downtown Way of the Word (8.7 km) and Way of Life (5.9 km) take half a day each; for the Way of Unity (29.5 km), which links the shrines along the Han River, allow a day or more using public transport.
조직위원회는 2025년 ‘9월愛 동행’에서 청년들이 이 길을 걸으며 순례: In the 2025 ‘September Companions’ program, the organizing committee had young people walk these routes collecting stamps in a pilgrim passport, then offer the passports at the Mass honoring the martyrs at Jeoldusan.
